necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent palpitations in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, corresponding to diagnosis codes R55, I48.0, and R00.2. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification.
